channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: ASCO redefines what global logistics leadership looks like
item.description: Logistics, materials and operations management firm, ASCO, has unveiled a refreshed identity, one that reflects its emergence as a global leader.

item.title: More than 2,000 hospitality businesses could close this year - six venues every day
item.description: More than 2,000 hospitality businesses will close this year due to rising business rates, the government has been warned by UKHospitality.

item.title: Owner and operator of Britain’s gas network to invest £870m in region
item.description: National Gas is set to invest £870m in the east of England over the next five years - updating control systems at its King’s Lynn and Diss compressor stations.

item.title: Building dating to the early 1800s to be transformed into a home
item.description: South Norfolk Council planners have approved an application to turn an office in Wymondham into a three-storey home.

item.title: Hotel's 1920s function room to be brought back to life
item.description: A hotel in the heart of the city centre is to bring a room believed to have hosted events more than 100 years ago back to life.

item.title: Trailblazing indoor vertical farm hails 'important milestone' for sustainable food
item.description: Fischer Farms has been awarded LEAF Marque accreditation for its vertical farm at the Food Enterprise Park at Easton, near Norwich.

item.title: Pub car park appeal rumbles on despite demolition plans
item.description: An entrepreneur is still locked in a battle with the council over the car park at his pub - despite lodging plans to demolish it.

item.title: Woman may have died from alcohol toxicity, inquest hears
item.description: A retired mortgage advisor from Long Stratton may have died from alcohol toxicity, Norfolk Coroner's Court has heard.

item.title: Calls for more security in HMO expansion plans on posh city road
item.description: Norfolk Constabulary designing out crime officers have called for more security measures as part of plans to turn a six-bedroom HMO on Newmarket Road into 10.

item.title: 100-year-old Canaries fan shares secret to living a long life
item.description: Ada Beckett, who worked in the laboratory for Norwich's world-famous chocolate factory, has celebrated a significant birthday with her family.
